title: Pollution: Vehicle smoke and stars
prompt: What does vehicle smoke do to the stars?
hint: Say that the smoke hides or blocks the stars.

ja.prompt: 車の煙は星に何をしますか？
ja.hint: 煙が星を隠す、または遮ると言ってください。

local.prompt: What does vehicle smoke do to the stars?
local.hint: Say that the smoke hides or blocks the stars.

local_pron.prompt: Wut duz vee-huh-kul smok doo to thuh stars?
local_pron.hint: Say thuh smok hiydz or bloks thuh stars.

zh.prompt: 汽车烟雾对星星有什么影响？
zh.hint: 说烟雾遮住或挡住了星星。

en.prompt: What does vehicle smoke do to the stars?

title: Fertilizer effect on ponds and fish
prompt: What does excess fertilizer do to ponds and fish?
hint: Say that too much fertilizer makes ponds green and kills fish.
sample: It causes ponds to become green and kills fish.

ja.prompt: 過剰な肥料は池と魚に何をしますか？
ja.hint: 肥料の過剰使用が池を緑にして魚を死なせると言ってください。
ja.sample: 池が緑になり魚を死なせます。

local.prompt: What does excess fertilizer do to ponds and fish?
local.hint: Say that too much fertilizer makes ponds green and kills fish.
local.sample: It causes ponds to become green and kills fish.

local_pron.prompt: Wut duz ek-sess fur-tuh-ly-zur doo to ponds and fish?
local_pron.hint: Say tuh much fur-tuh-ly-zur mayks ponds green and kilz fish.
local_pron.sample: It kaw-ziz ponds to bee-kum green and kilz fish.

zh.prompt: 過量的肥料對池塘和魚有什麼影響？
zh.hint: 說過多的肥料會使池塘變綠並導致魚死亡。
zh.sample: 它使池塘變綠並導致魚死亡。

en.prompt: What does excess fertilizer do to ponds and fish?
en.hint: Say that too much fertilizer makes ponds green and kills fish.
en.sample: It causes ponds to become green and kills fish.
